A '''Soul Reflector Manager''' is an NPC that allows you to create a [[Pankration]] monster or customise an existing monster. These NPCs are stationed in each of the four battle cages in [[The Colosseum]]:
*[[Idjham]]
*[[Abhrem]]
*[[Biwhal]] and 
*[[Whashai]]

==Management Options==
*'''Forge Soul Reflector'''
*:Trade 1 [[Soul Plate]] and 1 [[Ice Crystal]] to the NPC. You will automatically be charged a fee of 1 [[Jetton]].
*'''Add Skill to Soul Reflector'''
*:Trade your [[Soul Reflector]] and 1 [[Soul Plate]] to the NPC.
*'''Monster Name'''
*:See [[Pankration/Names]] for a list of names that can be chosen.

==Restrictions==
*You can only obtain each key once per Earth day.
*You must have the expansion registered to obtain keys specific to that expansion and in order to have the option to exchange items for the key, you must have completed the mission related to those items.
*Obtaining the [[Viridian Key]] from Squintrox Dryeyes will trigger a time limit on the mission [[Gatherer of Light (I)]], you will be unable to complete the mission until the following Earth day (after Japanese midnight).
**After completing the mission, you must wait until the following Earth day before you can exchange your items for the key.

| gender = Female | race = Tarutaru | job = | affiliation = Windurst | occupation = Star Sibyl | type = | location = [[Heavens Tower]], ''Cutscene only'' | starts missions = | starts quests = | involved in missions = *[[A New Journey|Windurst Mission 3-3: A New Journey]] * [[Magicite (San d'Oria)|San d'Oria Mission 4-1: Magicite]] * [[Magicite (Bastok)|Bastok Mission 4-1: Magicite]] * [[Magicite (Windurst)|Windurst Mission 4-1: Magicite]] *[[The Final Seal|Windurst Mission 5-1: The Final Seal]] *[[The Shadow Awaits|Windurst Mission 5-2: The Shadow Awaits]] *[[Saintly Invitation|Windurst Mission 6-2: Saintly Invitation]] *[[The Sixth Ministry|Windurst Mission 7-1: The Sixth Ministry]] *[[Doll of the Dead|Windurst Mission 9-1: Doll of the Dead]] *[[Moon Reading|Windurst Mission 9-2: Moon Reading]] *[[A Crystalline Prophecy (Mission)]] | involved in quests = | notes = The '''Star Sibyl''' is the formal name given to the [[Tarutaru]] leader of [[Windurst]]. She resides in the Vestal Chamber in the [[Heavens Tower]]. The current Star Sibyl, has been in power since before the [[Crystal War]]. The only ones allowed to see her are her body guards, her vassals, the Ministers of Magic, members of the Parliament of Patriarchs, and high ranking adventurers. She did, however, make one public appearance in the years following the Crystal War, where she urged her people to maintain a peaceful relationship with the [[Yagudo]] and to never use [[Summoning Magic]] again. She has complete trust in [[Semih Lafihna]], her personal Patriarch Protector. The Star Sibyl is blessed with the ability to read the stars in order to predict future events. She is not a character of many words, yet those words she utters are heartfelt. The '''Star Sibyl''' is more than a political leader, she is concidered the physical reincarnation of Altana in the [[Tarutaru]] religion. After the current Star Sibyl dies, female children are searched to find her new body and that child is taken and raised by the [[Heavens Tower]] nuns. Celibacy is expected of her vassals and, minus government officials, men are kept at a guarded distance from Her Holiness on a day-to-day basis. A notable exception was [[Karaha-Baruha]], an adviser she relied heavily on during the [[Crystal War]] whose death struck her especially hard. Her real name may be '''Miratete''', as suggested by the item [[Miratete's Memoirs]]. '''See Also''' * [[Tukuku]] (CE 290-298) | historicalbackground = }} {{Spoiler3 |spoiler= Each Star Sibyl carries a necklace known as the "Diza Star," a potent artifact passed from generation to generation that is needed to unlock the [[Book of the Gods]]. }}
